L17: Research Background
L18: Since 2013, I have published over 100 papers in top journals and conferences, including Usenix Security, ACM MM, TIFS, TPAMI, TVCG, TSC, TDSC, TKDE, and TIP, with over 10,000 citations on Google Scholar, an H-index of 60, and 18 ESI highly cited papers. I have also authored a scholarly monograph published by Springer. My research on image privacy protection focuses on building a system across three layers: data, content, and feature layers.
L19: I have published multiple review papers, including three in ACM Computing Surveys (impact factor: 23.8) and one first-author paper in IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials (impact factor: 34.4).
L20: I am leading national key R&D projects, as well as National Natural Science Foundation of China general projects and youth projects. I have been selected as an innovative and leading talent under the "Ganpo Talents Program" in Jiangxi Province.
L21: 
L22: From 2022 to 2024, I was listed in Research.com's global top computer scientists ranking. From 2021 to 2024, I was selected for the global top 2% scientists list published by Professor John P. A. Ioannidis's team at Stanford University.
L23: I have received several honors, including the Chongqing Outstanding Scholar Award (2016), ACM Chongqing Chapter Outstanding Scholar Award (2016), ACM Nanjing Chapter Rising Star Award (2020), and the Henan Provincial Natural Science Second Prize. In 2024, my ACM MM paper titled "Once-for-all: Efficient Visual Face Privacy Protection via Person-specific Veils" won the Honourable Mention Award.
L24: I serve as a member of the Digital Media Forensics and Security Committee and the Multimedia Committee of the China Society of Image and Graphics, as well as the Blockchain Committee of the China Cryptography Society and the Youth Committee of the China Society of Image and Graphics.
L25: I am an associate editor for four international SCI journals, including IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management (2nd district, CAS; impact factor: 5.3), Information Sciences (1st district, CAS; impact factor: 8.1), Journal of King Saud University-Computer and Information Sciences (2nd district, CAS; impact factor: 6.9), and Signal Processing (2nd district, CAS; impact factor: 4.4).
L26: I am also the editor-in-chief of "Chinese Journal of Computer Science Review" and a youth editorial board member for "Journal of Network and Information Security" and "Journal of Applied Sciences."
L27: #自2013年以来累计在Usenix Security、ACM MM、TIFS、TPAMI、TVCG、TSC、TDSC、TKDE、TIP、TC、JSAC 等顶刊顶会发表100余篇论文，Google引用1万余次，H指数64，ESI高被引论文18篇，Springer出版社出版学术专著1本。围绕图像隐私保护研究（依次从数据层、内容层、特征层三个层级）构建图像隐私保护体系，并发表多篇综述性论文，包括4篇通讯ACM Computing Surveys（影响因子：28.0）和1篇1作IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials （影响因子：46.7）。
L28: #主持国家基金青年项目B类(原优青)、国家重点研发课题、国家基金委面上项目、青年项目、江西省杰青、江西省重点研发项目等。入选江西省“赣鄱英才计划”创新领军人才。
L29: #2022-2024年入选Research.com发布的全球顶尖计算机科学家榜单。2021-2024入选斯坦福大学John P.AIoannidis教授团队发布的全球前2%顶尖科学家榜单。2024年入选ScholarGPS发布的高排名学者全球前0.05%顶尖科学家榜单。
L30: #荣获重庆市优博（2016年）、ACM重庆分会优博（2016年）、ACM南京分会新星奖（2020年）等称号、江西省自然科学奖一等奖、河南省自然科学奖二等奖等。2024年ACM MM论文《Once-for-all: Efficient Visual Face Privacy Protection via Person-specific Veils》荣获Honourable Mention Award。
L31: #CSIG数字媒体取证与安全专委，CSIG多媒体专委，CSIG青年工作委员会委员，CSIG南昌会员活动中心秘书长；中国密码学会区块链专委。
L32: #担任多个国际SCI期刊的副编，包括IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (CCF A， 影响因子：7.0)。 《中国计算机科学评论》主编，《网络与信息安全学报》、《应用科学学报》青年编委。
L33: #本人所在计算机与人工智能学院拥有计算机科学与技术一级学科博士点（2024年）。学院拥有财经大数据教育部工程研究中心、多媒体智能处理江西省重点实验室、江西财经大学司法鉴定中心、江西省人工智能质量检验检测中心等多个省部厅级科研平台。
L34: #本人所在计算机与人工智能学院成立于2024年，缺各路英才！欢迎博士们加盟!

L16: I am currently a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Department of Data Science, City University of Hong Kong (cite4†CityU†www.cityu.edu.hk ). Prior to this, I was a Postdoctoral Fellow at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (cite5†CUHK†www.cuhk.edu.hk ). I obtained my Ph.D. from Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics (cite6†NUAA†www.nuaa.edu.cn ). My research focuses on principled and scalable modeling of inductive bias for data representation.
L17: In particular, I study how cite7†invariance, symmetry, and hierarchy serve as inductive biases for learning in 2020s and beyond, and develop frameworks that are theoretically grounded, structurally transparent, and compatible with scaling. My research has been published in top-tier journals and conferences, such as ACM Computing Surveys, IEEE TPAMI, IEEE TIP, ICCV, and USENIX Security.

L16: # A Brief Introduction
L17: I earned my B.Eng. degree in Communication Engineering from Wuyi University, Guangdong, China, in 2018. Subsequently, I completed my M.S. degree in Information and Communication Engineering at Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, China, in 2021. Currently, I am a PhD candidate at the College of Electronics and Information Engineering, also at Shenzhen University.
L18: Additionally, I serve as a reviewer for IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS), IEEE Pattern Recognition (PR), and IEEE Transactions on Image and Video Processing (TIV). My research interests span trajectory prediction, anomaly detection, computer vision, and deep learning.

L20: # About me
L21: 
L22: I am a third-year Ph.D. student at the School of Computer Science, Fudan University, under the supervision of Prof. cite10†Yu Cheng†ych133.github.io . I received my B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology from Harbin Institute of Technology in 2023. I was a visiting student at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign from January to May 2026, and have also conducted research at the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
L23: My research is centered on large vision–language models, spanning visual agents, multi-step reasoning, hallucination mitigation, and multimodal safety. I am currently a research intern at the Multimodal Model Department, Tencent Hunyuan, selected for Tencent's “Project Up” Talent Program (青云计划) and the Rhino Bird Elite Talent Program (犀牛鸟精英人才计划). My work has appeared at ICLR, CVPR, and ACL. I also serve as a reviewer for NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, and TPAMI.
L24: I am always open for research discussions and collaborations. If you are interested, please feel free to contact me via email (mysong23@m.fudan.edu.cn).

L51: 个人情况简介
L52: 张银星，工学博士，特聘教授，硕士研究生导师，昆明理工大学高层次引进人才（四层次），云南省兴滇英才——青年学者。近年来围绕信息安全、保密通信、混沌理论、网络空间安全等研究领域，发表学术论文二十余篇。以第一作者(或导师第一、本人第二作者)身份在IEEE TSC、IEEE TII、 IEEE TCASI、IEEE TIE、IEEE TCASII、 IEEE TSMC-S、IEEE TSP、 Nonlinear Dyn.
L53: 和Chaos, Solitons & Fractals等国际著名顶级期刊发表多篇论文。发表中科院一区14篇，中科院二区5篇，单篇他引高达百余次。担任IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics、IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers、Artificial Intelligence Review等期刊审稿人。指导本科生和研究生参与竞赛并获多项奖项。主持或参与多个国家级和省级项目。诚邀计算机、通信、电子等相关专业学生加入团队，课题组致力于为每位同学提供融洽的学习氛围，使每位同学能最大限度地挖掘以及发挥自身的潜力。要求积极进取、乐观向上、责任心强。同时欢迎时间充裕及想保研的本科生加入课题组，目前，已指导一名本科生以第一作者身份在中科院一区期刊和IEEE Trans.期刊发表3篇论文。

L57: 向涛，教授，博导，重庆大学计算机学院院长，国家级人才，国家重点研发计划项目首席科学家，教育部“新世纪优秀人才支持计划”获得者，重庆市杰出青年基金获得者，重庆市英才计划创新领军人才，信息物理社会可信服务计算教育部重点实验室中心主任，四川省网络空间攻防对抗工程技术研究中心副主任，重庆市人工智能技术创新战略联盟副秘书长，重庆市信创联盟专家工作组成员，重庆市计算机类专业教学指导委员会委员，重庆大学学术委员会委员，香港中文大学、香港城市大学、美国马萨诸塞大学洛厄尔分校访问学者。
L58: 
L59: IEEE高级会员，中国计算机学会高级会员，中国密码学会高级会员，中国保密协会隐私保护专业委员会常务委员，中国电子学会电路与系统分会混沌与非线性电路专委会副主任，中国计算机学会区块链专委会委员，中国图象图形学学会数字媒体取证与安全专委会委员，中国密码学会混沌保密通信专委会委员，四川省计算机学会网络与信息系统专委会副主任。
L60: 主要研究方向为区块链、隐私保护、人工智能安全、多媒体安全、云计算安全、大数据安全等。承担了包括国家重点研发计划项目、国家自然科学基金重点项目、国家自然科学基金区域创新发展联合重点项目、国家自然科学基金面上项目、重庆市自然科学基金重点项目等20余项国家和省部级科研项目。发表CCF A类、IEEE/ACM会刊等论文200余篇，获得WASA、ProvSec等多个国际学术会议最佳论文奖。
L61: 
L62: 担任国际学术期刊IEEE Transactions on Cloud Computing、IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics等副主编，CCF推荐中文科技期刊《网络与信息安全学报》编委。并且先后担任50多个国际学术会议委员会主席/委员，出版学术专著2部，获得重庆市自然科学一等奖1项、重庆市科技进步一等奖1项、重庆市自然科学二等奖、中国电子学会自然科学二等奖、中国电子学会科技进步二等奖，获国家发明专利授权30余项。

L27: 
L28: I am an Associate Professor in the School of Computing and Information Systems at the University of Melbourne and an ARC Future Fellow. I am also the Course Director for the cite15†Master of Cybersecurity†onlineunimelb.edu.au . Before joining the University of Melbourne, I was a faculty member in the Faculty of IT at Monash University from 2017 to 2024.
L29: My work sits broadly in computer security, with a particular focus on secure networked systems, encrypted data processing, trustworthy machine learning, and the security of modern AI deployment.
L30: I am always interested in hearing from strong prospective students. Please email your CV, transcript, research statement (no more than 200 words), and English test score. Information on UniMelb PhD admission and scholarships can be found cite16†here†study.unimelb.edu.au , cite17†here†eng.unimelb.edu.au , cite18†here†www.csiro.au , and cite19†here .
L31: ## Research Themes
L32: 
L33: My current research agenda spans cryptographic systems, privacy-preserving learning, and the safeguards needed to deploy AI systems responsibly.
L34: 
L35: ### Encrypted data processing systems
L36: 
L37: Scalable and verifiable encrypted storage, leakage monitoring of searchable encryption schemes, and their deployment in large-scale systems such as CDN, DNS, and RAG pipelines.
L38: ### Privacy-preserving machine learning
L39: 
L40: Tailored MPC protocols for modern deep learning workloads, such as secure inference and training, with cryptographic guarantees.

L14: #### Overview
L15: I am interested in developing secure software systems with theoretical security / privacy guarantee and practical performance.
L16: My recent work has focused on data security (e.g., encrypted databases, multi-party encrypted analytics, proofs of remote storage, etc.), AI systems and security (e.g., red teaming for LLM, federated (un)learning, robust reinforcement learning, etc.), privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., encrypted messaging and metadata privacy, anonymous communications, encrypted network middleboxes, etc.), blockchain and decentralised applications (e.g., decentralized storage auditing, on-chain/off-chain interoperability, consensus designs, etc.), and software security and systems (e.g., hardware-assisted security, anti-fuzzing techniques, boosting performance of deep learning clusters, etc.).

L9: # About me
L10: Jian Weng is a professor with the College of Cyber Security in Jinan University. He received his Ph.D. from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2008. Over his career, he has published more than 100 papers in leading international conferences and journals, including CRYPTO, EUROCRYPT, ASIACRYPT, USENIX Security, NDSS, IEEE TPAMI, IEEE TIFS, and IEEE TDSC.
L11: Jian Weng has also successfully led over 10 major research projects in China, supported by the National Key R&D Program, the National Natural Science Foundation of China (including Distinguished Young Scholars, Key Program, General Program, and Young Scientists Fund), and several significant projects in basic and applied research in Guangdong Province.
L12: Research interests: public key cryptography, data security and privacy, blockchain

L24: Four layers, one lifecycle. Open a layer to see its keywords and topics.
L25: ### R Responsible and Resilient Cybersecurity Define responsibilities, manage cyber risks, and support prevention, recovery and adaptation.
L26: 
L27: The principles, methods and evidence needed to trust digital and intelligent systems in adversarial environments. This layer defines security responsibilities, manages cyber risk and makes sure systems can withstand, recover from and adapt to incidents.

L38: 
L39: Intelligent, data-driven and automated methods for understanding threats, finding vulnerabilities and defending systems. This layer brings together threat intelligence, security analytics, the security of emerging AI systems, and secure software engineering and testing.

L10: ## BIOGRAPHY
L11: 
L12: Weilong Peng is currently an Assistant Professor and Master’s Supervisor at the School of Computer Science and Network Engineering, Guangzhou University. He graduated from Tianjin University in July 2017. Prior to joining academia in July 2020, he served as a Senior Researcher at Tencent Youtu Lab.
L13: His research interests primarily focus on Computer Vision/Graphics(计算机视觉/图形学), Adversarial 3D Perception (3D 对抗感知) . During his tenure at Tencent, he developed the company’s first enterprise-level video human pose tracking solution, which has been widely deployed in core products such as Tencent Cloud and WeChat. Prof. Peng has published over ten papers in top-tier international conferences and journals, including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, MM, AAAI, ICDM, ICME, Pattern Recognition, TMM, TCE, ESWA, etc.
L14: He also serves as a reviewer for prestigious conferences and journals such as ICCV, ACM MM, Neurocomputing, IJCV, TIP, etc.

L118: 柴合言，博士，深圳大学计算机与软件学院助理教授,硕士生导师，于2024年3月获得哈尔滨工业大学博士学位，师从方滨兴院士和廖清教授，其后在香港中文大学计算机科学与工程系担任博士后。长期从事数据挖掘、人工智能、信息内容安全等相关理论及应用研究。近五年发表学术论文 16篇，以第一作者或共同第一作者发表顶刊/顶会9篇，包括CCF-A期刊/会议4篇，CSRankings会议4篇，中科院一区Top期刊1篇，如IEEE TKDE，IEEE TNNLS，ICDE，ACL，EMNLP等，已授权国家发明专利6项。长期担任ACL、EMNLP等国际顶级人工智能会议程序委员会委员，并担任多个人工智能和数据挖掘领域国际顶级期刊审稿人，如TKDE，TCYB，TNNLS，TKDD等。
